name: aitp
description: Begin physics research topics with aitp-memory; develop a concise research.md through research, writing and method distillation.

interface.shortDescription: Develop a coherent research note across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Use aitp-memory first to locate or establish the main note, recover context and determine the current task. Research, writing and domain methods develop one concise argument with linked evidence, useful failures and explicit uncertainty. For learning, expand source passages at the reader's needed depth; main notes synthesize the question and supporting notes develop usable results. Retain meaningful changes and distill reusable procedures. During use, repair materially outdated main notes within the current editing scope, preserving evidence and useful history; a usable note needs no rewrite. Produce or revise a LaTeX paper only when requested. No ledger runtime or automatic maintenance hook. Use aitp-human-brainstorming for unresolved research choices and aitp-human-learning for interactive conceptual learning. Reuse settled decisions; neither requires a separate phase or document. Main and branch notes explain which next inference advances the question.
defaultPrompt: Use aitp-memory first for this research topic: locate or establish research.md, recover its context and clarify this session's task.
Read the whole research note and recover this topic.
Integrate this result into the topic's argument.
Use aitp-writing to revise this physics explanation or manuscript.
Distill this demonstrated method into a focused Skill.
